messages:
morgan: Hey folks — PR #18921 (fix: rate limiter edge case) is ready and passes locally but the CI job is queued and not starting. Need to land before the deploy freeze at 19:00 PT today. Can someone give this a quick look or nudge the queue? :alarm_clock:

tess: pinging @sam for eyes, I can review after lunch but short on cycles before freeze. Which job is stuck? :eyes:

sam: I can grab it. job id? I have one free rerun token.

morgan: job 784321 (integration-windows). It reported a flaky failure earlier but reran fine locally. Logs show a timeout in the windows runner:```
ERROR TimeoutError: Browser didn't respond within 30s
  at tests/integration/setup.test.ts:42:12
```

ci-bot: CI Update — job 784321 queued on runner pool "windows-small" (position 12). Estimated start ~ 00:15:00. Link: https://ci.example/784321 :gear:

devops: Freezing traffic at 19:00 PT is firm. We have a short canary window at 18:30 PT (15m). If you need to land before freeze, we can do a manual merge + canary deploy, but it requires a devops sign-off and a rollback plan.

jordan: If the failing part is just the browser timeout, could you bump the timeout in the test to 45s in this PR? That would avoid a rebase. But that might mask a perf regression.

morgan: I prefer not to change test behavior for the sake of landing. Sam — can you trigger a manual rerun on the queued job and prioritize it? If it still fails, we can push the PR to the 18:30 canary.

sam: Reran job 784321 with priority tag. CI shows "started" on runner windows-small-12. Will watch. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: CI Update — job 784321 failed (integration-windows). Failure: intermittent browser timeout. Rerun available. Logs:```
TimeoutError: Browser didn't respond within 30s
Attempt 3/3
```

sam: Hmm still flaky. I can try a rerun on a larger runner pool (windows-medium) if you want. That would likely start in ~5m.

morgan: Yes please try windows-medium. If that doesn't land, push to canary slot 18:30PT and I will monitor. Also @devops can you confirm we can do a manual merge with automatic rollback if canary shows errors? :thumbsup:

devops: Confirmed — we can perform a manual merge and kick off canary at 18:30. If canary fails, we have an automated rollback script that runs within 2 minutes. Please add a short post-merge plan in the PR description.

sam: Rerunning on windows-medium now. job 784322. ETA start ~ 4m.

tess: Adding review now (quick pass). Small nits only, leaving :eyes: and approve after fix.

morgan: Thanks all. If 784322 fails, I will request the canary slot. If it passes, I will squash+merge and notify infra. :shipit:

ci-bot: CI Update — job 784322 succeeded on windows-medium. Artifacts: https://ci.example/784322/artifacts :tada:

sam: All green. @tess any last blockers for merge?

tess: No blockers from me, approved.

morgan: Merging now. Will watch canary and revert if anything odd. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
